title: A wild band of 19-to-29-year-olds
summary: Used to being the youngest, Malachi finds a band of cussing, drinking, pot-smoking young musicians who all loved each other.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: Which wasn't the case with the rest of the band. Because along with this music we were playing, I was introduced to some of the wildest young bunch of musicians that I ever met in my life, all together in one place. You have to remember that the oldest one in the band was Billy Eckstine, and he was 29 years old, and the average age in the band was round about 24 and young. I'd say their ages ranged from around 19 years old to Billy, which was 29. I think Dizzy was 26. I think I was 24 then. And I imagine Charlie Parker was about 23. And

they were all young...
I had never been around a bunch of guys that behaved like this, because the bands that I worked in, mostly before then, I was always the youngest guy. I was always in a band with older guys who behaved a certain way. I just had no idea that there were musicians behaving any other kind of way. And I went into his band, and guys did everything from swearin', cussin', drinkin', smokin' pot, using drugs -- the whole thing. It was just like a common, ordinary thing. Everybody was happy. Everybody in the band loved each other. It was just a happy situation. And always fun!
